summary: Backend-only testing of the finalize_confirmed_booking() refactor. Used the direct-injection approach recommended by main agent (bypassed Stripe LIVE). Created /app/backend/tests/test_finalize_refactor.py with 5 tests covering: (a) import + async-signature checks for all 7 helper functions, (b) _parse_start utility, (c) end-to-end call on a seeded confermato appointment verifying daily_room_url, riprogramma_token_hash, videocall_magic_hash, _confirmation_email_sent flag, informed_consent creation, (d) idempotency (2nd call does not rotate tokens nor resend confirmation), (e) HTTP 412 with 'Consenso Informato' message on POST /api/appuntamenti/{id}/video-token when patient has no granted consent. All 5 new tests PASS. Smoke suite (tests/test_iteration18_consent_reviews.py + tests/test_public_routes.py smoke subset) passes 18/18 when ADMIN_EMAIL=hr@funzionabene.it/@Bidoc2026! are exported (matches user's expectation).

minor.issue: TestReviewsAdminE2E in test_iteration18_consent_reviews.py defaults to admin@funzionabene.it, but real admin is hr@funzionabene.it. When run through run_smoke_tests.sh without setting ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars, 3 admin-authenticated tests get skipped (fixture pytest.skip). Cosmetic — no functional bug; user reports 18/18 requires the env override.

tests/test_public_routes.py::test_full_booking_flow (NOT in smoke suite) is stale — sends register payload without consenso_privacy/consenso_termini and fails 400. Pre-existing issue unrelated to the refactor.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update tests/test_iteration18_consent_reviews.py TestReviewsAdminE2E fixture to default to 'hr@funzionabene.it' or export ADMIN_EMAIL in run_smoke_tests.sh so the E2E admin block runs by default.

critical_code_review_comments: booking_service.py refactor is CLEAN: each helper has a single responsibility, all async I/O is properly awaited, no ObjectId serialization leaks. Idempotency guards are correct (early returns on hash presence + _confirmation_email_sent flag). Token digest uses sha256(ascii) consistently between generator (booking_service._token_digest) and validator (routers/appuntamenti._digest and informed_consents._digest). Good.

MINOR: _ensure_daily_room mutates the passed-in appt dict AND updates DB, while _ensure_reschedule_token / _ensure_videocall_magic_token only update DB and return the raw token. Slightly inconsistent contract — consider making all three helpers behave the same way (either all mutate + DB write, or all return values + let caller reconcile). Not a bug, just readability.

MINOR: finalize_confirmed_booking() calls _ensure_daily_room BEFORE checking the _confirmation_email_sent idempotency flag. This is correct (daily room may not exist even after email was sent, e.g. Daily.co outage on first call) but worth documenting. Same for token generation — they run before the idempotency short-circuit so partial state can self-heal.

MINOR: schedule_reminders() re-adds jobs with replace_existing=True on every call — good for self-healing but note that if _confirmation_email_sent=True the whole block is skipped, so idempotency prevents reminder duplication anyway.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 refactor tests, 18/18 smoke with correct admin creds)
